summary: This standards-track RFC clarifies how multiple simultaneous Bidirectional Forwarding Detection sessions are set up, kept running and torn down for a single MPLS label switched path and forwarding equivalence class. It updates RFC 5884 to remove ambiguity that could cause implementations to behave differently.

eli5.summary: Two friends keep checking in with each other to see if the road between them is still open. This clears up the rules for how several check-ins can run at once on the same road.

questions: multiple bfd sessions on one lsp
